faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating Polish into English.

items.q: Do I need to type Polish?
items.a: No. Speak the sentence into the mic or paste the message you received — the special characters never have to come from your keyboard.

items.q: Can it translate fast spoken Polish?
items.a: Yes. Record it and the English appears a couple of seconds after the person stops speaking.

items.q: Does it handle the case system?
items.a: The complete sentence is translated at once, so endings that mark subject and object are read correctly instead of being lost word by word.
Yes, your reply is translated into Polish in the same conversation and can be played aloud.
